title: Run to sanctuary before fear hardens
summary: The shabad begins with an unguarded cry: save me, Father; all virtues are Yours. Fear softens when it reaches sanctuary before it builds a self-protective shell.
takeaway: Ask for sanctuary before fear turns into hardness.
lifeApplication: At the first surge of panic, make the prayer plain: save me, I do not have the virtue to carry this alone.

source.shortMeaning: Fear is met by a direct cry for sanctuary, not by pretending self-sufficiency.
source.lifeApplication: In the first surge of fear, ask for shelter before strategy takes over.
